ab0f23a7: Who is the head of the Shelby family in Peaky Blinders?
Tommy Shelby is the family's chief strategist, a First World War veteran suffering from PTSD. Played by Cillian Murphy, he is the central character of the whole series.
0a9c4d64: Which actor plays Tommy Shelby in Peaky Blinders?
Cillian Murphy plays Tommy Shelby across all 6 seasons. His cold, intense and magnetic performance has been widely acclaimed.
d6014a4a: What is the name of the Shelby brothers' aunt, the gang's treasurer?
Polly Gray (née Shelby) is the family's aunt and treasurer, the backbone of the gang while the brothers were away at war. Played by the late Helen McCrory, she is one of the most beloved characters.
fd3fc585: Which actor plays Alfie Solomons, the Jewish gangster from Camden?
Tom Hardy plays Alfie Solomons, an unpredictable and philosophical Jewish gangster from Camden Town. His scenes with Cillian Murphy are among the series' most intense.
c5c297ea: Which inspector is the main antagonist of season 1?
Inspector Chester Campbell is the main antagonist of season 1, a Belfast policeman sent to Birmingham to crush organized crime. Played by Sam Neill.
2426741b: Who is the Shelby brothers' sister?
Ada Shelby is their sister: intellectual and politically engaged (with communist sympathies), she is the moral counterpoint to her brothers' criminal world. Played by Sophie Rundle.
2c1738ae: Which Italian-American gangster is the antagonist of season 4?
Luca Changretta is the Italian-American mobster who comes to avenge his family, the main antagonist of season 4. Played by Adrien Brody.
a98814a5: Who plays Oswald Mosley, the fascist of season 5?
Sam Claflin plays Oswald Mosley, a real historical figure who led the British fascist movement in the 1930s. His charm and rhetoric make him a particularly unsettling antagonist.
44a6fd5a: What is the first name of Polly Gray's son who joins the gang?
Michael Gray is Polly's son. Taken from her as a child, he finds his family again and joins the Shelbys. Played by Finn Cole, he evolves from innocent son into an ambiguous, dangerous figure.
f40fce3f: What is the name of the first woman Tommy Shelby truly loves?
Grace Burgess is Tommy's love in seasons 1 and 2, initially an undercover spy. Played by Annabelle Wallis, she marries Tommy but is killed in an attack in season 3.
2d31d793: How does Tommy make his money legally, as a front?
His betting business and Shelby Company Limited
Shelby Company Limited is Tommy's legal front, a betting business that helps launder criminal money. Tommy constantly tries to legitimize his business to protect his family.
82d8c09b: What is the Shelby family's official cover trade?
The Shelbys are officially bookmakers, taking legal bets on horse races. This legitimate business gives them the perfect cover for their criminal activities.
08c4451d: Which Shelby brother is the most violent and emotionally unstable?
Arthur Shelby is the most violent and emotionally fragile brother, deeply scarred by the war. Played by Paul Anderson, he is loyal to Tommy but uncontrollable when drinking.
5ffc04fb: Arthur's devout wife who tries to change him
Linda Shelby is Arthur's wife, a fervent Christian who tries to reform him and pull him away from crime. Her influence on Arthur creates tension with Tommy, who needs his brother in the gang.
8a3b7fd1: Who is Charlie Strong in Peaky Blinders?
Tommy's uncle who lives by the canal
Charlie Strong is Tommy's uncle. He runs the canal yard on the edge of Small Heath and sometimes acts as adviser and family memory, embodying the family's old guard.
52491cb5: In which Birmingham district do the Peaky Blinders operate?
Small Heath is the Peaky Blinders' home turf, a working-class district of post-war Birmingham. The Garrison pub serves as the Shelby family's main headquarters.
953f6fef: Which pub is the Peaky Blinders' headquarters?
The Garrison is the Peaky Blinders' iconic pub in Small Heath, where Tommy holds meetings, does business and spends much of his time.
8f78070e: In which main period is Peaky Blinders set?
Between the wars: the 1920s to the 1930s
Peaky Blinders is mostly set between the wars, from 1919 (season 1) to the 1930s (season 6), capturing the dark mood of a time of social and political tension.
e5a5a7a1: Who is the creator and showrunner of Peaky Blinders?
Steven Knight created the series and wrote the vast majority of its episodes, turning a regional crime drama into a worldwide cultural phenomenon.
18fa5d49: Which British network first aired Peaky Blinders?
Peaky Blinders aired on BBC Two, then BBC One, and became one of the BBC's biggest successes of recent years, in Britain and abroad.
b43dc9a6: How many seasons does Peaky Blinders have?
Peaky Blinders has six seasons, aired from 2013 to 2022. A film then continues Tommy Shelby's story.
5a3548e7: What is the Shelbys' main criminal business in the early seasons?
Illegal betting and control of horse racing
Controlling betting on horse races is at the heart of the Shelbys' business. Their illegal betting operation earns them enough to take over part of Birmingham's organized crime.
2a4f5812: Who is Billy Kimber in season 1?
The leader of a gang controlling the racecourses
A rival of the Lee family
Billy Kimber controls betting at the region's racecourses. Tommy has to outmaneuver him to take over his empire, the first great conflict that establishes the Shelbys' standing.
1ad9e234: Which Irish organization contacts Tommy in the early seasons?
The IRA (Irish Republican Army) contacts Tommy to get weapons: a complex relationship that puts him in as much danger as it offers opportunities.
9fedc4b4: What is Tommy's connection with the Russians in season 3?
He steals their imperial crown jewels
In season 3, Tommy gets involved in stealing jewels from the exiled Russian royal family, a complex plot that brings him into contact with the British secret services and fallen Russian aristocrats.
3f43ac86: What diagnosis does a doctor give Tommy in season 6?
A doctor tells Tommy he has a tuberculoma in his brain, supposedly fatal. At the end, the diagnosis turns out to be a lie.
c56d417e: Which real historical figure becomes an antagonist in season 5?
Oswald Mosley is a real historical figure, the leader of the British Union of Fascists in the 1930s. Bringing him into the series is one of its boldest choices.
54449f1b: Who is Lizzie Stark in the series?
Lizzie Stark starts out as a sex worker in Small Heath, becomes Tommy's secretary, then his wife after Grace's death. She gives him a daughter, Ruby.
7ab2b7f1: For which party does Tommy Shelby become a Member of Parliament?
Tommy is elected as a Labour MP in the later seasons, an attempt to give his business political legitimacy. His seat in Parliament offers him new opportunities.
803285b8: What is the Shelbys' signature phrase before taking action?
“By order of the Peaky Blinders” is the series' signature phrase, used as both threat and declaration of authority. It has become one of its most quoted lines.
88ae15e0: What is Tommy Shelby's relationship with opium and laudanum?
He uses them to cope with his war PTSD
Tommy regularly uses opium and laudanum to cope with the nightmares and PTSD left by the war, one of his most human vulnerabilities.
390ab33c: Which unexpected musical style accompanies Peaky Blinders?
Contemporary and indie rock (Nick Cave, PJ Harvey, Arctic Monkeys)
Peaky Blinders uses contemporary and indie rock (Nick Cave, PJ Harvey, Arctic Monkeys, Radiohead) over period scenes. This anachronistic choice is one of the series' boldest stylistic signatures.
484ab2fc: Where did Tommy Shelby serve during the First World War?
In the French trenches, leading a section of tunnellers
In India as a colonial officer
Tommy served with the tunnellers on the French front: they dug tunnels under enemy lines to plant explosives, one of the most traumatic jobs of the war.
a5e5fede: In what year does the action of season 1 begin?
Season 1 starts in 1919, just after the First World War. The Shelby brothers come home from the front traumatized, and Tommy starts building his empire amid the post-war chaos.
698104fa: John's wife, from the Lee family
Esme is John Shelby's wife. She comes from the Lee family, travellers, which echoes the Shelbys' own Romani roots.
5b341ae3: What role does Michael Gray play late in the series?
An ambiguous figure who betrays Tommy under his wife's influence
A hero who saves the family
Michael Gray becomes ambiguous and dangerous: influenced by his wife Gina, he plots against Tommy. His arc from innocent boy to potential enemy is one of the series' darkest.
b9c13bc2: Which English city is the main setting of Peaky Blinders?
Birmingham is the main setting, more precisely the working-class district of Small Heath. Its dark, industrial post-war atmosphere is a character in its own right.
ca496acd: How does Grace Burgess die in the series?
She is killed by the Peaky Blinders
She is shot at a gala targeted by the Shelbys' enemies
She is executed by the government
Grace is killed at a charity gala by a bullet meant for Tommy. Her death in season 3 is a devastating turning point for him.
cc489e2c: Which character was played by Helen McCrory, who died in 2021?
Helen McCrory played Polly Gray, the Shelbys' aunt and guiding spirit. Her death in 2021 deeply affected the production of season 6, which honors her memory.
31d717e4: What is the relationship between Tommy and Winston Churchill in the series?
Churchill uses Tommy as an unofficial intelligence agent
Churchill uses Tommy as a go-between for matters the government cannot handle officially: espionage, dealings with the IRA and secret operations. The relationship is fictional.
20c787e6: What crime sets the Peaky Blinders' story in motion?
The theft of a shipment of military weapons just after the war
At the start of the series, Tommy quietly steals a shipment of military weapons. The incident quickly draws in the IRA and the secret services, pulling the family into a dangerous spiral.
4ea8c86c: What is Grace Burgess's real job before joining the Shelbys?
An undercover agent for the police (Irish RIC)

Grace Burgess is sent by Inspector Campbell as an undercover agent; she works for the Royal Irish Constabulary. Her secret identity and her real feelings for Tommy drive the central tension of season 1.
bb321f0a: Who is Aberama Gold in the series?
A professional killer and Shelby ally linked to Polly
Aberama Gold is a traveller and professional killer who allies with the Shelbys and becomes romantically involved with Polly. Played by Aidan Gillen.
a6233e74: What is Finn Shelby's role in the family?
The youngest, gradually drawn into the criminal business
A character absent from the series
Finn Shelby is the youngest brother. Over the seasons he grows up into the Peaky Blinders' world, going from sheltered child to active member of the family organization.
7ba3d31e: In which season is John Shelby killed?
John Shelby is killed at the start of season 4, in an attack orchestrated by Luca Changretta and the Italian-American Mafia, establishing the seriousness of the threat.
6cb2e0b8: What is Tommy Shelby's full name in the series?
Thomas Shelby; his full name is never revealed
Thomas Michael Shelby is Tommy's full name: Michael is his middle name, which sometimes causes confusion with his cousin Michael Gray.
4d6f172e: What does the name “Peaky Blinders” mean according to the series?
A military nickname from the Great War
A reference to the razor blades sewn into their flat caps
The name of an alley in Small Heath
A nickname given by the Birmingham police

“Peaky Blinders” comes from their flat caps: according to the series' legend, they sewed razor blades into the peaks to use as weapons. The story is historically disputed but central to the show's mythology.
b1668f93: Who is the main antagonist of season 2 of Peaky Blinders?
Darby Sabini, the Italian-British gangster who controls the racecourses of southern England, is the main threat of season 2. Tommy must maneuver against him while handling complex alliances.
16877e72: How was Helen McCrory's death handled in season 6?
Polly's death is not shown on screen
Polly dies off-screen between seasons and her absence is woven into the story
Another actress takes over the role
Helen McCrory died in 2021 before season 6 was filmed. Polly Gray dies between seasons, and the series pays her a moving tribute. Season 6 is dedicated to Helen McCrory.
e025c83e: Paul Anderson plays Arthur, the eldest brother. Joe Cole plays John and Finn Cole plays Michael.
5c7a97aa: Annabelle Wallis plays Grace. Sophie Rundle plays Ada, Helen McCrory Polly and Natasha O'Keeffe Lizzie.
fdc11fc7: Sophie Rundle plays Ada, the Shelbys' sister, across all six seasons.
66347ef9: Adrien Brody, an Oscar winner for The Pianist, plays the New York mobster of season 4.
cd46aff7: Which song is the theme of Peaky Blinders?
“Red Right Hand” by Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds
“Paint It Black” by the Rolling Stones
“Seven Nation Army” by the White Stripes
“Red Right Hand” by Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds opens every episode and fits the series' dark mood.
e0041b0f: What is the name of Tommy and Grace's son?
Charles, nicknamed Charlie, is Tommy and Grace's son.
f9088db6: What illness kills Ruby, Tommy's daughter, in season 6?
Little Ruby succumbs to tuberculosis, a tragedy that crushes Tommy.
54fe36f7: Which business serves as a front for Alfie Solomons's rum distillery?
Alfie Solomons makes his illegal rum behind the front of a bakery in Camden Town.
da6d5f76: What is the name of Ada's first husband, a communist activist?
Freddie Thorne, Tommy's former comrade in the war, is a communist activist. He marries Ada against the family's wishes.
4cf70907: Polly shoots Campbell in revenge for what he did to her.
ab8d6e1f: What is the name of the trade unionist Tommy gets involved with in season 5?
Jessie Eden, a real Birmingham union figure, is in contact with Tommy during season 5.
90bbc740: What is the name of Michael Gray's American wife?
Michael marries Gina, an ambitious American and niece of the tycoon Jack Nelson.
85cf4d6a: What is the title of the film that continues the Peaky Blinders series?
By Order of the Peaky Blinders
The film The Immortal Man, again starring Cillian Murphy, continues Tommy Shelby's story after season 6.
6158cd4c: Which aristocratic horse trainer has an affair with Tommy in season 2?
May Carleton, a wealthy widow passionate about horses, trains Tommy's horse for the Epsom Derby.
